# Plan — LEGSMOKE-1140 "Upgrade rehearsal push child (/tmp/legion-e2e4b.178207.rtvOSiAa)"

Repository `sjawhar/legion-smoke`, default branch `main`, issue branch `legion/LEGSMOKE-1140`, one pull request from it to `main`.

## Spec basis and the one departure

The child's own spec (`dispatch://LEGSMOKE-1140/artifact/spec`, v1) has no body. The root spec (`dispatch://LEGSMOKE-1135/artifact/spec`, v2, Summary: "add one new Markdown file under `smoke/` holding a single line that names this issue") is the design this plan follows, with `LEGSMOKE-1140` in place of `LEGSMOKE-1135` for the file name, the key the line carries, the branch, and the `.legion/` path. Evidence for the swap: `smoke/` holds 138 files, one `smoke/LEGSMOKE-<key>.md` per issue key, each a single line `<KEY>: <issue title>` (read: `smoke/LEGSMOKE-1070.md`), and the sibling trees of this proof each merged their own key's file (`main` tip `6d843f28` is `smoke: add LEGSMOKE-1070 marker file (#767)`). This is recorded as a spec departure (`specDepartures[0]`): the root's acceptance names `smoke/LEGSMOKE-1135.md`; this child's work owes `smoke/LEGSMOKE-1140.md` and nothing to `smoke/LEGSMOKE-1135.md`. Whether the child's empty spec gets a body is the architect's call; the plan proceeds on the swap.

## Planning pre-state (2026-10-24T21:5xZ, read with this pane's gh and jj)

- `fork_point(main@origin | @-)` = `main@origin` = `legion/LEGSMOKE-1140@origin` = `6d843f28732dd82163065cb4d2248e488f68ca0b`.
- `gh api 'repos/sjawhar/legion-smoke/contents/smoke/LEGSMOKE-1140.md?ref=main'` → HTTP 404.
- `gh api 'repos/sjawhar/legion-smoke/commits?path=smoke/LEGSMOKE-1140.md&sha=main' --jq 'length'` → `0`.
- `gh pr list -R sjawhar/legion-smoke --head legion/LEGSMOKE-1140 --json number` → `[]`.
- Required status check on `main` (`gh api repos/sjawhar/legion-smoke/rules/branches/main`, rulesets): `["gate"]`. The branch-protection endpoint answers 403 to the review App; the ruleset read is the one to repeat.
- Workflows (read in workspace): `ci` job `check` = `sleep 20 && exit 0`; `fail-on-demand` job `gate` = checkout then fail iff `.fail-me` exists at the root. `.fail-me` absent.
- No test suite, lint, build or index consumes `smoke/*.md` (repo-wide grep for `smoke/LEGSMOKE` matches only retro notes under `docs/solutions/legion/`). README.md is an append log, not an index. Nothing else in the repository changes.

**Invalidating facts** (the implementer stops and reports to the architect if any changed; a moved `main@origin` alone is not one — measure from the fork point, per `docs/solutions/legion/measure-the-issue-branch-from-its-fork-point-LEGSMOKE-1016.md`): the 404 at `?ref=main`; `commits?path=…&sha=main` = 0; no open PR with head `legion/LEGSMOKE-1140`; required checks still `["gate"]`.

## The change (exact)

One new file `smoke/LEGSMOKE-1140.md`, 80 bytes, exactly:

```
LEGSMOKE-1140: Upgrade rehearsal push child (/tmp/legion-e2e4b.178207.rtvOSiAa)
```

followed by one `\n`, no CR, no BOM. Pinned: `wc -c` = 80, `wc -l` = 1, sha256 `9178f322969d7d9617ff3816e3b1e8058039705a4424ca6063a7b81061e59134`. Every phase compares bytes to these constants, not to "contains the key".

Second line (only if the reviewer's round asks for one): the reviewer's thread states the exact text; the implementer appends it as line 2 with a trailing `\n` and leaves line 1 byte-identical. The deciding artifact is the reviewer's GitHub review state `CHANGES_REQUESTED` with a thread on `smoke/LEGSMOKE-1140.md` naming the line (`gh api repos/sjawhar/legion-smoke/pulls/<n>/reviews --jq '[.[] | {state, commit_id}] | tostring'`), mirrored in `.legion/LEGSMOKE-1140/review.json` `decision`. An `APPROVED` first round means the file stays at one line through the merge. The round's `wc -l` target is therefore 1 or 2 and nothing else.

Every phase worker runs AGENTS.md's one rule first: `mkdir -p /tmp/legion-fixture && touch /tmp/legion-fixture/agents-md`. No criterion asserts it (it is repository hygiene outside the PR); each handoff notes it ran.

## Acceptance criteria as machine-checkable predicates, with surface and command

Reads use the GitHub contents API at an explicit SHA, never the shared workspace checkout, and jq flags go inside the filter (`docs/solutions/legion/put-jq-flags-inside-the-filter-for-the-pane-gh-wrapper-LEGSMOKE-1070.md`). `firstCodeHead` = the first pushed commit carrying `smoke/LEGSMOKE-1140.md`, recorded by the implementer in `implement.json`.

- **A1 new file** — surface: GitHub contents API. Command: `gh api 'repos/sjawhar/legion-smoke/contents/smoke/LEGSMOKE-1140.md?ref=<firstCodeHead>' --jq '.sha'` → 200 with a blob sha. Negative control (pinned before the merge makes it unreachable): the same read at `?ref=6d843f28732dd82163065cb4d2248e488f68ca0b` (fork point) and at `?ref=main` → HTTP 404, plus `commits?path=smoke/LEGSMOKE-1140.md&sha=6d843f28…` → `0`. After the merge the fork-point read stays 404 and remains the control.
- **A2 one line, contains key** — surface: contents API bytes. Command: `gh api 'repos/sjawhar/legion-smoke/contents/smoke/LEGSMOKE-1140.md?ref=<firstCodeHead>' --jq '.content' | base64 -d | tee /tmp/l1140.md | wc -c -l; sha256sum /tmp/l1140.md; tail -c1 /tmp/l1140.md | od -An -tx1` → `1 80`, sha256 `9178f322…e59134`, last byte `0a`. Negative control: `printf 'LEGSMOKE-1140x: …\n' | sha256sum` mismatches (the constant distinguishes a one-character change).
- **A3 second line only on request** — same surface at the round's code head. If the review asked: `wc -l` = 2, `head -1` byte-identical to the pinned line (`head -1 /tmp/l1140.md | sha256sum` with the trailing newline → `9178f322…`). If it did not: at the approved head (`gh api repos/sjawhar/legion-smoke/pulls/<n>/reviews --jq '.[] | select(.state=="APPROVED") | .commit_id'`, per `docs/solutions/legion/read-the-approved-head-from-github-not-the-review-handoff-LEGSMOKE-1062.md`) `wc -l` = 1 and sha256 unchanged. Negative control: the review-state read shows no `CHANGES_REQUESTED` (or shows it, in the two-line case).
- **A4 changed files** — surface: `gh pr diff <n> --name-only`, evaluated at the head of the phase doing the read (the set grows by one `.legion/LEGSMOKE-1140/*.json` per phase and shrinks at retro, per `docs/solutions/legion/size-the-pr-body-by-the-paths-that-merge-LEGSMOKE-1022.md`). Predicate: every line matches `^(smoke/LEGSMOKE-1140\.md$|\.legion/LEGSMOKE-1140/|docs/solutions/)` and `smoke/LEGSMOKE-1140.md` appears exactly once. Check: `gh pr diff <n> --name-only | grep -Ev '^(smoke/LEGSMOKE-1140\.md$|\.legion/LEGSMOKE-1140/|docs/solutions/)'` prints nothing; `gh pr diff <n> --name-only | grep -c '^smoke/LEGSMOKE-1140\.md$'` → `1`. `docs/solutions/` is permitted, not required: retro writes a note when it has one; acceptance does not fail on its absence. At the merge, owned by the implementer's production check (step 9): `gh api repos/sjawhar/legion-smoke/commits/<mergeSha> --jq '[.files[].filename] | tostring'` lists `smoke/LEGSMOKE-1140.md`, optionally `docs/solutions/…`, and no `.legion/` path. Negative control: the filtered set at `fork_point…firstCodeHead` (`gh api 'repos/sjawhar/legion-smoke/compare/6d843f28…...<firstCodeHead>' --jq '[.files[] | select(.filename | startswith(".legion/") | not) | .filename] | tostring'`) is exactly `["smoke/LEGSMOKE-1140.md"]`.
- **A5 CI green** — surface: GitHub Actions check-runs. Command: `gh api repos/sjawhar/legion-smoke/commits/<codeHead>/check-runs --jq '[.check_runs[] | {name, status, conclusion, id}] | tostring'` → `check` and `gate` each `completed`/`success` (two entries per job: one `push`, one `pull_request` run; cite the `pull_request` pair in the CI line and name the `push` pair). Negative control (read-only; never create `.fail-me`, which Scope forbids and which would snapshot into the next commit): at the trailered handoff head, `gh api repos/sjawhar/legion-smoke/commits/<handoffHead>/check-runs --jq '.total_count'` → `0` and `gh pr view <n> -R sjawhar/legion-smoke --json mergeStateStatus,mergeable --jq 'tostring'` → `mergeStateStatus` `BLOCKED` while `mergeable` is `MERGEABLE`, showing the query distinguishes a head with no runs from a green one (`docs/solutions/legion/prove-a-docs-only-change-by-its-bytes-at-an-explicit-sha-LEGSMOKE-1021.md`). `ci`'s `check` cannot fail by design; the required check is `gate` alone.
- **A6 merged to main** — surface: contents API at `main` after the close. Command: `gh api 'repos/sjawhar/legion-smoke/contents/smoke/LEGSMOKE-1140.md?ref=main' --jq '.content' | base64 -d | wc -l` → 1 (or 2 if the review asked), sha256 of line 1 = `9178f322…`. Who records it: the implementer's post-merge production check (the role prompt's "production check after the close"), reported with `handoff_complete` and a verdict; the tester proves the merge-equivalent at the approved head under A3 and records that the merge itself is proven only by the production check. Negative control: the fork-point 404 from A1.

## Phase tasks and ordering

### Implementer
1. Run the AGENTS.md fixture command; `cd -- "$LEGION_WORKSPACE"`; read `.legion/LEGSMOKE-1140/plan.json`.
2. Re-read the four invalidating facts; record them and `fork_point(main@origin | @-)` in `implement.json` `preState`. Record any `main@origin` advance as a deviation, not a stop.
3. `jj new` per the turn-start rule; `printf 'LEGSMOKE-1140: Upgrade rehearsal push child (/tmp/legion-e2e4b.178207.rtvOSiAa)\n' > smoke/LEGSMOKE-1140.md`; verify locally `wc -c -l` = `1 80`, sha256 `9178f322…`. Guard: `jj diff --from 'fork_point(main@origin | @-)' --to @ --name-only` lists only `smoke/LEGSMOKE-1140.md` and `.legion/LEGSMOKE-1140/` paths.
4. `jj split -m "smoke: add LEGSMOKE-1140 marker file" smoke/LEGSMOKE-1140.md`; identity check per `skill://legion-worker/references/default-branch-check.md`; bookmark set + `jj git push --bookmark legion/LEGSMOKE-1140` (code push: no trailer).
5. `gh pr create -R sjawhar/legion-smoke --base main --head legion/LEGSMOKE-1140 --title "smoke: add LEGSMOKE-1140 marker file"` with the template body from `skill://legion-worker/references/pr-body.md` as that template places its fields (the Dispatch key `LEGSMOKE-1140` where the template puts it, which satisfies the daemon's `Dispatch: LEGSMOKE-1140` fallback link), a `Size:` line as the filtered merge diff (`smoke/LEGSMOKE-1140.md` +1/−0; handoffs excluded, removed by retro), and the CI line once runs complete.
6. Wait for check-runs at `firstCodeHead`; prove A1, A2, A4, A5 with the commands above at `firstCodeHead` (A5 at the code head), each with its negative control; write `proof` entries (six strings each, `headSha` = the explicit SHA read) into `implement.json` plus `firstCodeHead`, `prNumber`, `preState`, `deviations`.
7. Handoff: write `.legion/LEGSMOKE-1140/implement.json`; `jj split -m "implement: record handoff"`; trailered push; `handoff_complete`.
8. If a later review round asks for line 2: append the reviewer's exact text, re-verify `head -1` unchanged and `wc -l` = 2, code push, reply and resolve the thread per `skill://legion-worker/references/review-threads.md`, re-prove A2/A3/A4/A5 at the new head.
9. After the merge closes the issue: the production check — A6 (file bytes at `?ref=main`) and A4's merge-commit predicate (`commits/<mergeSha>` files: the smoke file, optional `docs/solutions/…`, no `.legion/` path) — reported with `handoff_complete` and a verdict.

### Tester (runs the application, not CI again)
1. Fixture command; read `plan.json` and `implement.json`.
2. Re-run A1, A2, A4 at `firstCodeHead` and at the current head, independently, and compare bytes to the plan's constants — not to the implementer's observed values. Read A5 from GitHub at the code head (static work is CI's).
3. Try to break it: read at `?ref=main` and the fork point (404 both); check `tail -c1` is `0a` and no `\r` (`grep -c $'\r'` → 0); check `gh pr diff --name-only` has no stray path; check the PR body's `Size:` against the filtered compare set; confirm no `.fail-me` on the branch (`gh api 'repos/sjawhar/legion-smoke/contents/.fail-me?ref=<head>'` → 404).
4. Write `test.json`: `implementerProof` (each entry verified or disputed), `failures` (`[]` when none), own `proof` array; edit the tester's `E2E (tester)` line in the PR body; trailered push; `handoff_complete` with `verdict`.

### Reviewer
1. Fixture command; read `plan.json`, `implement.json`, `test.json`; read the plan beside the root spec and this plan's departure.
2. Check the diff is the one file at the pinned bytes (A2 via the contents API at the read head), A4's predicate holds at the head read, the PR body lines are current, and both proofs name explicit SHAs and real negative controls.
3. Decide: approve, or request exactly the second line (state its exact text in the thread). Record `decision`, counts, `keyFindings`, `readHead` (never `approvedHead`) in `review.json`; trailered push; approve the head that push made; `handoff_complete`.

### Architect acceptance, retro, merger
- Acceptance compares the approved SHA from GitHub (`pulls/<n>/reviews`) to the tester's and reviewer's heads.
- Retro removes `.legion/LEGSMOKE-1140/`, may add `docs/solutions/legion/*-LEGSMOKE-1140.md`, refreshes `Size:`; its push carries no trailer.
- Merger builds READY on the head after retro; required check `gate` green at that head; the daemon merges.

## Required skills
- implement: `legion-worker` (handoff, push, PR body, proof rules); `dispatch` for any issue message.
- test: `legion-worker` (tester's proof and PR-body rules; `references/pr-body.md`).
- review: `legion-worker` (`references/merge-gate.md`, `references/review-threads.md`).
No repository skill applies: `fixture-omp-skill` and `fixture-claude-skill` are one-token Stage 4b fixtures with no instructions.

## Risks
- The fixture driver may end phases mid-run (this child is an "upgrade rehearsal push" proof): a worker resumed later re-reads its committed handoff and the branch tip before acting; nothing in this plan depends on pane memory.
- Sibling trees advance `main` while the PR is open: measure from the fork point, never from `main@origin`.
